text:
maria: kicking off canary for private VPC control-plane bundle v1.4 — sending 2% traffic to new rollout for three air-gapped sites. pls watch propagation and auth errors.

sahil: are we enforcing the 2% split at the dataplane or control-plane? iirc air-gapped nodes pull configs on a schedule, so split might be applied unevenly.

maria: split is configured in the control-plane routing policy (canary_percent). dataplane applies when it receives the bundle. expected stagger.

julian: deploybot just created bundle and checksum. note: we upload bundle to internal mirror, then run `redwoodctl sync-bundle --site <site>` — that step is manual for air-gapped. watch the sync logs.

deploybot: Bundles created: bundle_id=rb-bundle-20260202-1543, checksum=sha256:9f...

lina: quick UX ask — console should surface per-site last-applied-bundle timestamp and a health delta. currently it's too coarse (global). can we add per-site propagation column?

maria: +1. also want a propagation guard: if a site lags > 10m for the canary, automatically pause traffic increase and alert ops.

sahil: for guard thresholds, propose: if error_rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency regression > 25% vs baseline OR last_applied_ts delta > 10m => hold canary and notify.

julian: agree. add a special check for KMS failures since air-gapped sites often need key rotation sync. a missing KMS mapping will cause auth failures that look like 5xx.

ops-bot: ALERT: site 'eu-private-1' bundle sync failed (checksum mismatch). no traffic was directed.

maria: thanks ops-bot — pausing rollout for eu-private-1. rolling back traffic there to 0%. starting investigation.

lina: product asks for an A/B variant id in telemetry so we can surface quality metrics by variant in the eval dashboards. canary percentage alone isn't enough.

sahil: we already have variant.tags but not wired end-to-end. will add `variant_id` in request traces and metrics (trace_id -> variant_id). needs a tiny schema bump on ingestion.

maria: note for implementers: in air-gapped mode we must avoid changing traffic routing semantics mid-sync. recommend config: `canary_epoch: <iso>` + `canary_percent` + sticky_shard: true so sessions stick to the variant until bundle applied.

message snippet (example rollout policy):
```yaml
rollout:
  id: canary-2026-02-02
  canary_percent: 2
  epoch: 2026-02-02T15:40:00Z
  guards:
    max_error_rate: 0.005
    max_p95_increase_pct: 25
    max_prop_delay_seconds: 600
  sticky_shard: true
  fallback: full-rollback
```

julian: smaller note — when sticky_shard=true we need to stall autoscaling decisions for nodes that haven't seen the new model binaries else cache mismatches happen. add annotation to autoscaler to ignore canary-variant nodes for 15m.

maria: operational play: if any site has unresolved checksum or KMS errors after 15m, we abort globally and mark bundle as "requires manual sync". ops will run `redwoodctl bundle-status --site` and `redwoodctl force-apply` once mirror verified.

sahil: coding task: add per-site propagation timestamps to the rollout resource and expose via console API `/rollouts/{id}/sites`. will also emit metric `rollout.site_propagation_delay_seconds`.

lina: UX task: show per-site state (pending/synced/failed) with one-click abort and a hint explaining air-gapped manual step. also add a tiny timeline of events.

maria: ok action items: 1) sahil add variant_id to traces/metrics + rollout.site_propagation_delay_seconds; 2) julian add autoscaler annotation; 3) lina console changes; 4) ops doc the manual sync checklist. i'll keep the canary at 2% and monitor.

ops-bot: NOTE: scheduled check in 5m for eu-private-1.

sahil: if anyone sees unexpected 401/5xx spikes in the first 10m, tag me and i'll flip the site to fallback.

maria: thanks team. updating runbook with the guard thresholds now. :wave:
